name: @discere-os/libexpat.wasm
description: High-performance Expat XML parsing library with WebAssembly and TypeScript-first API

imports.module: data:application/javascript,export const createRequire = () => (id) => { if (id === 'path') return { dirname: () => '', join: (...args) => args.join('/') }; if (id === 'url') return { fileURLToPath: (url) => url.replace('file://, '') }; if (id === 'fs') return { readFileSync: () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); } }; throw new Error(`Module ${id} not found`); }; export default { createRequire };
imports.path: data:application/javascript,export const dirname = () => ''; export const join = (...args) => args.join('/'); export default { dirname, join };
imports.url: data:application/javascript,export const fileURLToPath = (url) => url.replace('file://', ''); export default { fileURLToPath };
imports.fs: data:application/javascript,export const readFileSync = () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); }; export default { readFileSync };

tasks.build:main:meson: meson setup build-main --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-main expat-main && meson install -C build-main
tasks.build:side:meson: meson setup build-side --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-side expat-side && meson install -C build-side
tasks.build:wasm:meson: deno task build:main:meson && deno task build:side:meson
tasks.clean: rm -rf build-* install/ dist/ npm/ && echo '✅ Cleaned all build artifacts'
